en-US.description: YARA-X is a re-incarnation of YARA, a pattern matching tool designed with malware researchers in mind. This new incarnation intends to be faster, safer and more user-friendly than its predecessor.
en-US.name: YARA-X
en-US.releaseNotes:
- Compile Unicode character classes in regular expressions using UTF-8 byte sequences for smaller and faster PikeVM code (1baf65c).
- Add support for \b{start-half} and \b{end-half} word boundary assertions in regular expressions (e89aaae).
- Improve Scanner creation performance by reusing the WASM linker (#841).
- Auto-discover libmagic library search path when building with the magic-module feature (64dd140).
- BUGFIX: Allow --ignore-module to ignore modules implemented by YARA-X (#833).
- BUGFIX: Don't mistake maps containing encoding and value keys for encoded values in the Python API (#832).
- BUGFIX: Fix memory leaks in the Go API when Destroy isn't called on Scanner or Rules (c465b46).
- BUGFIX: Fix false positive E048 (ConditionTooLarge) errors when multiple rules share a WASM function (71cfcc9).
- BUGFIX: Support regular expressions in with statements without panicking (6b7bbb7).
- BUGFIX: Handle literal null bytes in metadata strings without panicking (c557033, d970018).
- BUGFIX: Fix overlapping undefined-variable bitmaps in WASM memory when rules use more than 8 variables (2fcf36e).
- BUGFIX: Roll back anchored_sub_patterns when restoring compiler snapshots after a rule fails to compile (e2153a9).
- BUGFIX: Fix multiple loop hoisting and variable stack issues in the compiler (3b09b1e, 1cdf204, a2a4823, 0165856, 14ec84b).
- BUGFIX: Fix panics, integer overflows, and excessive memory usage when compiling large patterns, wide patterns, hex jumps, and multi-pattern regex sets (f2fa044, ac2e94b, 7883874, 294a49a, c46e2a7, 0f71e3b, eed7687).
- BUGFIX: Fix panics, infinite loops, and error span mapping in relaxed_re_syntax mode (64c2a16, 431834f, e3a6a23, 95cd52e, fb2332a).
- BUGFIX: Fix stack overflows on deeply nested expressions, span overflows on large inputs, and Unicode whitespace handling in parser and formatter (9e89546, 9137a19, 64d4d90, b107e9d, 985d3cd, 46ea1af, c7d4afb, 24d964f).
- BUGFIX: Fix integer overflows, 32-bit offset truncation, WASM page boundary slices, and large runtime string handling in compiler and scanner (02c6d37, 3af8e05, 852fed0, 77d84c8).
- BUGFIX: Fix arithmetic overflows and panics on unset fields in math, hash, console, and pe modules (e7510e2, 220a268, 30074ca, 8001188, 8f4999a).
- BUGFIX: Fix panics and unbounded recursion in yr check, yr deps, yr fix warnings, and the tags linter (360f42f, d90d431, b2293bd, f489e2d).
- BUGFIX: Fix multiple issues in the Language Server, including unbounded recursion, lexical scoping in find_declaration, UTF-16 column mapping, and stale CST caching (2c0360c, b4b9192, 5a1c488, 8b6d7f1, 1973e8a, b3e1ffe).
